"Build a complete, self-contained HTML web app (using Tailwind CSS, Three.js r128 or glossy HTML5 Canvas, Web Audio API, and localStorage auto-save) for an AFK / Idle Car Racing, Stat Upgrading, and Card Pack Collection game with 21 glossy, reflective track environments.

1. Core AFK @COMMENT_BODY@ Championship Loop
- Autonomous Racing: Your equipped car drives, drifts, and races automatically around the active track without requiring constant input, earning Cash ($/lap and $/sec), XP, and Trophies while you watch or idle (including offline earnings calculated from localStorage timestamps when you return).
- Championships: Include a multi-tier Championship ladder (Rookie Cup, Street League, Pro Grand Prix, Elite Tour, and World Apex Championship). Entering a Championship pits your car against AI rivals in a multi-lap race; winning unlocks higher tiers, trophy multipliers, and bonus Card Packs.
- Speed @COMMENT_BODY@ Camera Controls: Include 1x / 2x / 4x AFK race speed toggles, a dynamic follow camera / full-track view toggle, and a Sound On/Muted toggle.

2. Stat Upgrades @COMMENT_BODY@ Garage Progression
- Upgradable Stats: Let players spend Cash to upgrade Top Speed, Acceleration, Cornering Grip, Nitro Boost, and Race Payout Multiplier, with clear level counters, cost scaling, and Buy x1 / x10 buttons.
- Prestige / Pit-Crew Reset: Once players reach high Championship tiers, allow a Prestige reset for permanent Golden Wrenches that boost all future Cash and drop rates.

3. Car Card Packs @COMMENT_BODY@ Collection
- Card Pack Shop: Offer 3–4 pack tiers (Standard Pack, Pro Pack, Neon Pack, Legendary Pack) purchasable with Cash or Championship Trophies.
- Pack Opening Experience: Animate pack opening with glowing rarity reveals (Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary) and confetti/sound effects.
- Car Roster @COMMENT_BODY@ Merging: Include 15+ distinct car types (Compact Coupes, Muscle GTs, Police Interceptors, Pickup Trucks, Drift Vans, RC Buggies, Off-Roaders, Mid-Engine Supercars, and Formula Racers). Collecting duplicate cards lets players merge/star-up cars to boost their base stats and unlock metallic/clear-coat paint finishes.

4. Glossy, Reflective Tracks @COMMENT_BODY@ 21 Environments
- Visual Quality: Render every track with glossy, reflective road surfaces (wet-look specular sheen, dynamic headlight reflections, neon/sunlight glints, tire skid marks, drift smoke, and metallic cars with reflective windows and drop shadows).
- 21 Distinct Roads @COMMENT_BODY@ Environments (unlockable as you progress or buy locations):
  1. Metro City (wet asphalt @COMMENT_BODY@ skyscrapers)
  2. Neon Cyberway (glowing cyan/magenta grid @COMMENT_BODY@ holograms)
  3. Desert Canyon (sun-baked highway @COMMENT_BODY@ sand dunes)
  4. Alpine Snow (icy curves @COMMENT_BODY@ pine forests)
  5. Frozen Lake (mirror-like ice surface @COMMENT_BODY@ snow spray)
  6. Tropical Coast (oceanfront boardwalks @COMMENT_BODY@ lighthouse)
  7. Volcanic Ridge (obsidian roads @COMMENT_BODY@ glowing lava rivers)
  8. Industrial Port (cargo containers @COMMENT_BODY@ steel docks)
  9. Jungle Temple (mossy stone roads @COMMENT_BODY@ ruins)
  10. Moon Crater (low-gravity lunar dust @COMMENT_BODY@ domes)
  11. Candy Kingdom (glossy sugar roads @COMMENT_BODY@ pastel landmarks)
  12. Golden Vault (gilded marble track @COMMENT_BODY@ spotlights)
  13. Sunset Highway (warm golden-hour coastal freeway)
  14. Rainy Expressway (heavy rain reflections @COMMENT_BODY@ puddles)
  15. Cherry Blossom Touge (mountain hairpins @COMMENT_BODY@ falling petals)
  16. Crystal Cavern (bioluminescent crystals @COMMENT_BODY@ wet stone)
  17. Autumn Forest (red/gold leaf-covered country roads)
  18. Mars Colony (red-dust canyon @COMMENT_BODY@ solar arrays)
  19. Skyway Cloudbridge (elevated glass road above the clouds)
  20. Haunted Hollow (misty cobblestone @COMMENT_BODY@ lantern glow)
  21. Prism Void (iridescent rainbow-reflective track)

5. Polish @COMMENT_BODY@ UI
- Organize the interface into clean, mobile-friendly tabs: Race @COMMENT_BODY@ Championships, Upgrades, Card Packs @COMMENT_BODY@ Garage, and 21 Worlds.
- Include Web Audio API synthesized sound effects for pack openings, upgrades, lap chimes, and championship victories. And include skin packs to by that get more expensive and rare for the cars.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

- Build a complete, self-contained idle racing, upgrading, collection, championship, and world-selection web game.

## Requirements
- Provide autonomous racing with lap cash, XP, trophies, offline earnings, speed and camera controls, and sound toggles.
